svg.text: Online Closed-Loop Agentic Fuzzing and Adaptive Feedback Loop

g.text: • Locks Target Invariant φi + Dedicated ISA Checker
• Allocates uniform execution budget T per target
• Ensures equal opportunity across all invariants
Target Queue: Invariant Catalog Φ (topological dispatch)
Conditioned on formal φi + Level-3 predicates from Stage 3
// runtime dimensions force dynamic stack frame
// forces compiler backend to emit defense check
// return address LR', and epilogue stack check
>> Streamed directly to Dual Deterministic Oracle
Dual Deterministic Machine Oracle O(P, I, S)
Deterministic Function: O : P × I × S → {PASS, FAIL, NA, ERROR}
Multi-Dimensional Feedback Ingestion via Bash & MCP:
• Compiler diagnostics, warnings, and optimization records (-fopt-info)
• UID probe hits: hit_count(UID) tracking unreached critical conditions
• Detailed Oracle execution traces and DWARF register offsets
If condition unreached (e.g., has_vla == false), generates precise
syntactic mutation instructions to steer Generator Agent.
When rule ambiguity votes ≥ τ: triggers automated checker rewrite,
AND immediately replays the entire historical seed pool H
against new checker to catch previously masked violations.
Does NOT terminate on first bug! Drives Generator to amplify finding:
nested structs, flexible array members, alloca() chains
Maximal Vulnerability Discovery across Alternate Backend Lowering Paths
